### Feature Summary
A concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

### Problem Statement / Academic Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or course requirement? (e.g., "Students need to filter records by semester/batch...")

### Proposed Solution / Architecture
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented:
- **Backend API Endpoints:** (e.g., `POST /api/students/bulk-import`)
- **Database Schema Updates:** Any new fields or constraints.
- **Frontend UI Components:** Modern responsive interfaces in Tailwind CSS and React.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features considered.

### Checklist
- [ ] Requirements aligned with course syllabus (24TU05IT01).
- [ ] Database normalization and referential integrity preserved.
- [ ] Unit & integration test plan documented.
